name: Ike
bio: Ike was donated as a puppy by Illini Spirit Standard Poodles. In March 2020 he became a full-time service dog and moved to his forever home with his new handler.
alt_text: Ike, a black standard poodle in an orange Illini bandana, sitting outdoors

name: Alma
bio: Alma joined ISD in 2017, donated by the Lindeen family and breeder Lisa Huizenga. She was placed with her new handler in February 2020.
alt_text: Alma, a yellow Labrador, wearing an ISD graduation cap

name: Maizey
bio: After a little more than two years of training, Maizey graduated in spring 2018 and moved to Alabama. She helps her partner by retrieving objects, turning lights on and off, and opening and closing doors.
alt_text: Maizey, a tan and white dog in an orange vest and graduation cap, lying on the grass and smiling

name: Abe
bio: Abe entered the program as a puppy and, after more than two years of training, was placed in California in March 2017. He helps by retrieving objects, counterbalancing and bracing.
alt_text: Abe, a yellow Labrador in a working harness, lying on the floor
